description.en: Adds a delete entry to the session row menu. Sessions are copied to a local backup folder with per-file verification before the originals are removed, and the workspace ledger is cleaned before and after deletion. Sub-agent sessions are collected through parentSession and handled together. Supports a backup-free mode, a configurable backup location, and four backup folder naming styles.
description.zh: 在会话行菜单中加入删除入口。删除前先把会话复制到本地备份文件夹并逐文件校验，校验通过才移除原文件，同时清理工作区记账。通过 parentSession 递归收集子代理会话一并处理。支持不备份模式、自定义备份位置，以及四种备份文件夹命名方式。
